summary: Electron Hub's free tier grants $0.25 in weekly API credits, refilled every Sunday at 21:00 UTC (unused weekly credit does not carry over), plus 10 Neutrinos per day for :free-suffixed models — expandable to 200 Neutrinos/day by watching up to 3 ads.
claim_steps: Sign up at app.electronhub.ai (no card required for the free tier).
Weekly credits land automatically every Sunday 21:00 UTC; Neutrinos reset daily at 21:00 UTC.
Call models ending in :free to spend Neutrinos instead of credits; watch ads in the dashboard to raise the daily Neutrino cap to 200.

social_proof.title: Understanding Credits — Electron Hub Docs
social_proof.text: Weekly Credits are automatically added to your account every Sunday at 21:00 UTC; Free tier receives $0.25. All users get 10 Neutrinos per day (resets 21:00 UTC); earn more by watching ads, up to 200 daily.
